description: Idempotency + audit log for ERPNext sales postings (connector spec 006). One row per posted Data-Pulse-2 sale, keyed on (source_system, external_id) — the 012 O-3 wire idempotency anchor. The unique index on that pair is what makes posting exactly-once (Gate G5): a replay resolves to the recorded document_ref instead of creating a second ERPNext document.

fields.label: Source System
fields.description: DP2 sourceSystem (012 provenance, maxLength 100). Part of the idempotency key.

fields.label: External Id
fields.description: DP2 externalId (012 provenance, maxLength 200 — NOT the default 140, to avoid truncating a long id into a false duplicate). With source_system forms the unique replay key.

fields.label: Document DocType
fields.description: The posted ERPNext document's doctype (e.g. "Sales Invoice"). Generic {doctype, name} addressing (Principle II).

fields.label: Document Name
fields.description: The posted ERPNext document's name. Echoed back to DP2 on an idempotent duplicate posted ack.

fields.label: Sale Ref
fields.description: DP2 saleRef (008 sale id) — audit linkage.

name: Posting Log
